high_level_description: The image is a still from an ABC News segment featuring a person wearing a dark hoodie with the hood up. The individual appears to be outdoors, standing in front of a building with white siding and a window visible in the background. The person is also wearing glasses. The text overlay on the image reads: "The gun was so big and long that I genuinely thought... Okay, this is the end of the road for me." This quote is attributed to Brown University teaching assistant Joseph Oduro, who describes the moment a gunman burst into his lecture hall.
